name: Corrupted Avenger (Lathspell Archetype)
body:
Spellcasting

A corrupted avenger does not gain spells.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A corrupted avenger is proficient in all simple and martial weapons as well as all armor and shields.

Challenge (Su)

At 1st level, the corrupted avenger gains the ability to issue a challenge. As a swift action, the corrupted avenger chooses one target within sight to challenge. The corrupted avenger’s attacks deal extra damage whenever the attacks are made against the target of this challenge. This extra damage is equal to the corrupted avenger’s class level. The corrupted avenger can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day for every three levels beyond 1st, to a maximum of seven times per day at 19th level.

This challenge requires a singular focus and so the corrupted avenger suffers a -2 penalty to armor class against attacks from creatures other than their target.

The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious or until the combat ends, and the corrupted avenger can only maintain one challenge at a time.

Your challenge also gains an additional effect based on your curse as follows:

Altered Perception: While under the effects of your challenge you gain scent with a range of 30 feet. At 10th level you also gain tremorsense with a range of 30 feet.
Death: While under the effects of your challenge you deal additional damage equal to twice your class level rather than your class level against foes with fewer than 1/2 their normal hit point total.
Entropy: While under the effects of your challenge you gain Improved Sunder as a bonus feat. At 10th level whenever you successfully cause a weapon or held item to gain the broken condition you may make an attack against its wielder at your highest base attack bonus as a free action. If you already have Improved Sunder, you gain an additional +2 to sunder combat maneuvers.
Misfortune: While under the effects of your challenge you and your target are unaffected by concealment in regards to one another. At 10th level you and your target ignore total concealment in regards to one another.
Mutable Form: While under the effects of your challenge you gain an enhancement bonus to natural armor equal to 1/4 your class level (minimum +1).
Pain: Whenever you deal damage to the target of your challenge with a melee attack they must make a Fortitude save (using your lathspell’s curse DC) or be sickened for one minute. At 10th level if the target of your challenge fails this save by 5 or more they become nauseated for one round and then sickened for one minute instead.
Violence: While under the effects of your challenge you also gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to 1/4 your class level (minimum +1).
Rage Power (Ex or Su)

At 5th level, you gain a rage power from among those available to barbarians using your class level as your barbarian level for all requirements and effects. You may use this rage power while under the effects of your challenge. Unlike a barbarian, the corrupted avenger may take rage powers from multiple totems, representing how their spirit seems to attract the sort of magic that requires a host. You gain an additional rage power at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. This ability replaces the expanded knowledge abilities normally gained at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

Bonus Combat Feat: At 6th and again at 11th level you gain a bonus combat feat. You must meet the prerequisites of this feat.

Grim Determination (Su)

Once you have challenged a foe you become incredibly difficult to escape. As long as you maintain an active challenge you are under the effects of freedom of movement as the spell with a caster level equal to your class level.

This ability replaces the cursed strike ability normally gained at 8th level.

Vengeful Retaliation (Ex)

Your challenge can be ended early for a burst of frightening power. When the target of your challenge deals 10 or more damage to you in a single melee attack you may make an attack of opportunity against them, even if you have no attacks of opportunity remaining for the round. This attack is made with a doubled critical threat range which stacks with other such effects. If the attack hits, your challenge ends after totaling the damage. If the attack is a critical hit, the target must make a Fortitude save equal to your lathspell’s curse DC or become shaken for 1 minute. Once you use this ability you must wait one minute before issuing a new challenge.

This ability replaces the penetrating curse ability normally gained at 12th level.
